terbaru.judul: QuantFactor REINFORCE: Mining Steady Formulaic Alpha Factors with Variance-bounded REINFORCE
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper first argues that the originally employed policy training method, i.e., Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), faces several important issues in the context of alpha factors mining.

terbaru.judul: Gradient Reduction Convolutional Neural Network Policy for Financial Deep Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: Building on our prior explorations of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for financial data processing, this paper introduces two significant enhancements to refine our CNN model's predictive performance and robustness for financial tabular data.

terbaru.judul: Explainable Post hoc Portfolio Management Financial Policy of a Deep Reinforcement Learning agent
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we developed a novel Explainable Deep Reinforcement Learning (XDRL) approach for portfolio management, integrating the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with the model agnostic explainable techniques of feature importance, SHAP and LIME to enhance transparency in prediction time.

terbaru.judul: Deep Reinforcement Learning Strategies in Finance: Insights into Asset Holding, Trading Behavior, and Purchase Diversity
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper aims to investigate their tendencies towards holding or trading financial assets as well as purchase diversity.

terbaru.judul: $\text{Alpha}^2$: Discovering Logical Formulaic Alphas using Deep Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we propose a novel framework for alpha discovery using DRL by formulating the alpha discovery process as program construction.

terbaru.judul: Deep reinforcement learning with positional context for intraday trading
terbaru.pelajaran: In this study, we propose a novel DRL model for intraday trading that introduces positional features encapsulating the contextual information into its sparse state space.

terbaru.judul: Exploiting Distributional Value Functions for Financial Market Valuation, Enhanced Feature Creation and Improvement of Trading Algorithms
terbaru.pelajaran: Instead of focussing on the more complex task of finding optimal decision rules, this paper studies and applies the power of distributional state value functions in the context of financial market valuation and machine learning based trading algorithms.

terbaru.judul: Optimizing Deep Reinforcement Learning for American Put Option Hedging
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper contributes to the existing literature on hedging American options with Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL).

terbaru.judul: Hedging American Put Options with Deep Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: As such, not only does this study present the first DRL agents tailored for American put option hedging, but results on both simulated and empirical market testing data also suggest the optimality of DRL agents over the BS Delta method in real-world scenarios.

terbaru.judul: Portfolio Management using Deep Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: In our work, we propose a reinforced portfolio manager offering assistance in the allocation of weights to assets.
